arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader
from pypdf.generic import DictionaryObject, NameObject, DecodedStreamObject
from datetime import date

ds = date.today().strftime("%B") + " " + str(date.today().day) + ", " + str(date.today().year)
title = "Annual Financial Report"
t1 = "BT /F1 36 Tf 1 0 0 1 107.91 540 Tm (" + title + ") Tj ET"
t2 = "BT /F1 16 Tf 1 0 0 1 240.63 470 Tm (" + ds + ") Tj ET"
body = "q\n" + t1 + "\n0.5 g 0.5 w 186 505 m 426 505 l S\n" + t2 + "\nQ\n"

w = PdfWriter()
pg = w.add_blank_page(width=612, height=792)
cs = DecodedStreamObject()
cs.set_data(body.encode("latin-1"))
pg[NameObject("/Contents")] = cs

f1 = DictionaryObject()
f1[NameObject("/Type")] = NameObject("/Font")
f1[NameObject("/Subtype")] = NameObject("/Type1")
f1[NameObject("/BaseFont")] = NameObject("/Helvetica")
fo = DictionaryObject()
fo[NameObject("/F1")] = f1
rs = DictionaryObject()
rs[NameObject("/Font")] = fo
pg[NameObject("/Resources")] = rs

with open("cover_page.pdf", "wb") as fh:
    w.write(fh)

out = PdfWriter()
out.add_page(pg)
r = PdfReader("report.pdf")
for p in r.pages:
    out.add_page(p)
with open("report_with_cover.pdf", "wb") as fh:
    out.write(fh)

print("OK merged; total pages:", 1 + len(r.pages))
PYEOF
